	COLDWAR_SAF_dec_accept_cub_accord = {
		icon = generic_diplomacy
		visible = { original_tag = CUB has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_offer_cub_accord_pending }
		available = { original_tag = CUB has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_offer_cub_accord_pending SAF = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_offer_cub_accord_open COLDWAR_SAF_pair_CUB_clear = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_signed } } }
		cost = 0
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_SAF_dec_accept_cub_accord"
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_CUB
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_onetime_done } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = SAF.gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.002 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_par_wk_inc_tt
			SAF = {
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_SAF
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_onetime_done } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.002 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_saf_wk_exp_tt
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_signed
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_onetime_done
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_FLV_deal_partner
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_offer_cub_accord_pending
				SAF = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_signed
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_deal_cub_accord_onetime_done
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_SAF_offer_cub_accord_open
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_SAF_BILAT.115 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 4 }
	}
